How the shape thinks

All passive. Intelligence in geometry. Ready for sensing.

01

Pressure, redistributed

Load on one compliant unit stiffens its neighbors, spreading force across a larger area. At the foot, the hand, the joint.

02

Nothing to fail

No actuators, no electronics required. Over a million compression cycles with no loss of function. And when data is wanted, the same architecture integrates sensing.

03

Energy, returned

Shape morphing structures store and release energy with every step. Human gait and robotic locomotion alike.
